thought.text: Callback succeeded and redirected to claim selection. Now fetch the page and verify `groups` is present:

reasoning_content: Callback success → 302 to /admin/bootstrap/select-claim. This time, the claims should include `groups: [instance_admin]`, email, and name. Fetching the selection page.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt --max-time 10 "http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap/select-claim" -o selectclaim2.html -w "select-claim: [%{http_code}]\n"
grep -o 'name="admin_group_claim_choice" value="[^"]*"' selectclaim2.html | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"$//' | sed 's/"/"/g'
grep -o 'name="_csrf_token" value="[^"]*"' selectclaim2.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//' > sc_csrf.txt
